text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- New Communications and Works Minister Leondios Ierodiakonou manages to solve an 11-year-old dispute on the routing of a new road in the Larnaca district.
- President Glafcos Clerides says he does not expect violations of Cyprus's airspace during the military exercises planned between Israel and Turkey.
- Cyprus tells Turkey to contribute to the climate of talks and stop violating its airspace.
- Germany expresses support for a direct dialogue on the Cyprus dispute.
- Communist Akel and socialist Edek continue deliberations on cooperating in next years' presidential elections.
- Akel has rejected the candidacy of socialist Edek party leader Vassos Lyssarides in the presidential poll.
- Town planning authorities will order the demolition of an extra floor illegally built at a hotel under construction belonging to the family of former foreign minister Alecos Michaelides.
- Akel and Edek cannot agree on a presidential candidate.
- A Cyprus Airways pilot grounded his plane at Paphos airport, refusing to work an extra 10 minutes in order to fly the plane to Larnaca, its destination.
